character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Rotate this exact south-facing sprite into eight coherent views. Strong muscular Afro-Brazilian warrior, dark brown skin, shirtless with clearly visible pale pink scars on chest and arms, short dark hair and short beard, off-white trousers rolled below the knee with earth stains, pink-red cloth sash with one long blade tucked at the waist. Left foot raised on a low brown rock with the knee bent and his left hand resting on that knee; right hand holds a very tall wooden spear with a broad leaf-shaped iron blade. Broken iron shackles on both ankles with a short dangling chain end each, the legs are not chained together. Keep the same pixel scale, colors, line weight and proportions in every direction; spear and rock fully inside the canvas; transparent background, no ground shadow, no text.
